zones.name: Central Plaza
zones.description: Open public space at the village core with the grand hero statue as its centerpiece.

actions.name: Admire Hero Statue
actions.description: Stand in front of the statue and look at the hero's carved likeness.

zones.name: Blacksmith's Forge
zones.description: West-side workshop where the blacksmith once forged the hero's legendary sword, now makes household cutlery.

actions.name: Browse Handmade Spoons
actions.description: Look at the neatly stacked, well-crafted spoons the blacksmith has made.

zones.name: Healer's Cottage
zones.description: East-side small cottage where the healer once treated wounded adventurers, now sits mostly unused.

actions.name: Browse Herb Shelves
actions.description: Look at the neatly arranged dried medicinal herbs on the shelves.
